column1: # The red run: this tree's assertions against the engine the base ref holds,
# written whole by tests/red, which tests/run --record-assertions calls.
#   run   <failed>  <passed>  <skipped>        lines counted, not the summary
#   <assertion name>  <times it failed>        failed names only
#   an assertion the manifest lists that the base run never reached counts as failed, by its shortfall
# A base of - means no complete red run was made: none was possible, the
# suite stopped before reached or reached no assertion, or tests/red itself
# was stopped; its stdout said which unless it was the one stopped.
instrument removers: IR2: the watchdog exits 0 in every round of that race
instrument removers: IR2: the watchdog, its PATHs given J R UP HP BD BD.list and another process removing J once PARENT is gone, leaves none of them, in every round

instrument removers: IR3: a shell running _felix_instr_watch over its own bind copy, KILLed while another process removes J, leaves none of BD, BD.list, J, R, UP and HP within a few seconds, in every round

instrument removers: IR3: with no other remover, a shell KILLed after _felix_instr_watch reaches a moment where BD and BD.list are gone while J, whose removal takes a while, is still there, in every round
instrument removers: IR4: the supervisor exits 125 in every round of that race
instrument removers: IR4: the supervisor's judge-gone path, another process removing J once the unit's group is gone, leaves none of J R U UP HP, in every round
